description: The closed sets of the Record event's emitter (written_by) and principal kinds (the <kind> of actor), PERD v1.17 section 32.1 (DEC-2026-10-27-actor-and-payload-hash). The one machine-readable source in the core: the writer and the verifier derive their sets from this file (go:embed) and keep no list of their own. contracts/schemas/record-event.v3.json lists the same values, and tools/contracts/test_record_event_v3.py and record/chain/types_test.go fail when the two differ. scope RUNTIME: the core may append as this identity. Any other scope: the contract lists the identity and the core refuses it.

emitters.name: core-outcome
emitters.note: identities table; read as the own adapter identity of REQ-VER-001 (PERD 29), which names none

emitters.name: benchmark-runner
emitters.note: identities table; holds the oracle credential; the core never appends to the Record as this identity, so the core refuses it while the contract lists it

emitters.name: admin
emitters.note: identities table, control plane; also a principal kind, with a different meaning (see principal_kinds)
